newsitem.title: UK: Investor seeks to change Eurasia jv terms.
newsitem.headline: Investor seeks to change Eurasia jv terms.

text.p: Eurasia Mining Plc said an investor was trying to invalidate a provision of its joint venture agreement with Russian company Yuzhuralzoloto (YUZ).

Through court action, the investor -- who is an unnamed "substantial" shareholder of YUZ -- seeks to prevent the transfer of the mining licence of the Svetlinskoye deposit into the joint venture, Eurasia Mining said.
Eurasia said it and YUZ will vigorously defend their joint venture agreement.
But Eurasia added it and YUZ would likely go-ahead with the joint venture even if the investor would succeed in keeping the mining licence provision out of the venture's agreement.
"It is very likely that we would proceed, but we would have to find alternative means not to slowdown the implementation of the join venture," Eurasia's finance director Clive Line told Reuters.
The 50:50 venture to develop the Svetlinskoye gold deposit in the southern Urals region of Russia was announced last month.
The Svetlinskoye deposit represents one of a number of precious metals projects in the Urals in which Eurasia holds interests.
